note: Every family the 0.2.7 product persists, the evidence 0.2.8's cards read: its writers and readers by module, its location kind, its bytes on one real workspace (null when that workspace holds none), its data class (one of the eight below) and shape tier (1 core, 2 versioned definitions, 3 contract content, 4 opaque bodies), and the 0.2.8 table that takes it or the reason it retires. A writer is module:Class or module:function; the commit refuses a persisting writer no family lists. Only later cards move a family.
measured_on: one real workspace, the QA original ls1-chain (15.3 GB, 4,138 files), read in place and read-only on 2026-11-14 on the workshop's main Windows machine (Intel Core, 32 logical CPUs) while the workshop's other lines ran; bytes are DuckDB blocks in use per table, SQLite pages per table, or file sizes under each path prefix, none of which depends on load. null: the measured workspace holds none of the family, or it lies outside a workspace
